title: GE HealthCare expands global collaborations to help define the future of photon-counting CT with Photonova Spectra
lineage: Corroborates the GE–UW collaboration while describing different research and implementation stages at other institutions.

passages.locator: Opening; Leading institutions expand Photonova Spectra’s research network
passages.note: Announces a seven-institution network in North America, Europe and Asia and mentions CE marking, U.S. clearance and Japanese regulatory authorization. The participating sites are described as conducting or planning structured evaluations.
